title.en: The Household Ledger and the Merchants Council

desc.zh: 海口税关的账册摊在王府长案上，船主代表坐在下首。摆上桌的不是现成银款，而是三种本国办法：公开账目争取信用、以王府名义担保，或由商界提出优先报关的条件。每条路都先缴本国登记费。
desc.en: The customs ledgers lie across the household table, with shipowners below. No outside purse is on offer: the choices are domestic terms—open the books in pursuit of credit, put the household name behind a guarantee, or propose priority clearance for merchants. Each route begins with the country’s filing fee.

desc.en: The harbour council lists seven lanes and three flotillas. options.effect: { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_limited_target_selected } } set_variable = { name = ywc_jhg_tribute_limited_target_selected value = 1 } remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_notice_delivery_active remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_notice_delivery_12 remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_notice_delivery_36 remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_notice_pending_event remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_12_notice_delivered remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_36_notice_delivered remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_12_notice remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_36_notice remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_six_months_complete remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_limited_six_months_complete remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_observation_armed remove_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_observation_timer set_variable = { name = ywc_jhg_tribute_observation_route value = var:ywc_jhg_tribute_route } } else = { ywc_jhg_tribute_close_as_compromise = yes } }

cost_note.en: No fee.

consequence_note.zh: 将当前路线切换为该路线的较低资格目标；所有相关条件连续满足180天后，才可选择有限和解。
consequence_note.en: Switches the current route to its lower qualified target. A limited settlement becomes available only after all conditions hold continuously for a fresh 180 days.

options.trigger: { OR = { AND = { has_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_notice_delivery_active has_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_notice_delivery_36 } AND = { has_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_limited_target_selected has_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_limited_six_months_complete } } ywc_jhg_finance_safe = yes var:ywc_jhg_tribute_route > 0 }

purpose.zh: 结算事件只写结果、不再收费，并把 legacy 变量 ywc_je_flavor_jhg_convoy_1 写实。
purpose.en: The settlement event charges nothing further and writes the legacy variable ywc_je_flavor_jhg_convoy_1.
